**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (preferred position).**

- **Only responsive location:** § 2.2 Extensions (p0055). § 2.1 (p0054) and the "Term" definition (p0049, eight years from the Commencement Date) merely cross-refer to it; a full-document search for "renew"/"extend"/"automatically" turned up no other renewal or uplift mechanic (§ 8.14 pricing changes are default-driven, not renewal-driven).
- **No automatic renewal:** the Agreement expires unless the parties agree renewal terms, so the conditional preferred elements (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder) are not engaged, and Customer carries no non-renewal notice window at all.
- **No renewal uplift:** the sole unilateral extension right belongs to Customer, for one 12-month period "at the then-current terms and conditions," so the CPI/3% cap element is not triggered.
- No redline proposed; the clause runs in our favour.
